text: Our paper "What to Distinguish and How? Opportunities and Challenges of Augmenting Multiple, Cluttered Objects in Complex Scenes for People with Low Vision" is accepted to **ASSETS 2026**! (Acceptance rate: **30.18%**) 🎉
I received the **Gold Reviewer Award** at **ICML 2026**! 🏅

Our paper "How Much Future Helps? A Controlled Study of Future-Privileged Supervision for Causal Egocentric Gaze Estimation" is accepted to the **7th International Workshop on Eye and Gaze in Computer Vision (GAZE 2026)** at **CVPR 2026** and received the **Best Paper Award**, including an **NVIDIA RTX 5080** sponsored prize! 🏆
Our paper "Mitigating the ID-OOD Tradeoff in Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation" is accepted to **CVPR 2026 Findings**! 🎓
Our paper "Do Audio-Visual Segmentation Models Truly Segment Sounding Objects?" is accepted to **AAAI 2026 Main Track**! (Acceptance rate: **17.6%**) 🎉
Our paper "Toward Gaze Target Detection in Young Autistic Children" is accepted to **AAAI 2026 AISI Track**! (Acceptance rate: **24.1%**) 🎉
I served as a Reviewer for **ICLR 2026**.
I served as a Reviewer for **CHI 2026** and **AISTATS 2026**.
I served as a Reviewer for **AAAI 2026**.
I served as a Reviewer for **TMLR** and **ICCV Workshop 2025**.
I served as a Reviewer for **NeurIPS 2025**.
I served as a Reviewer for **ICML 2025**.
I was in the **top reviewers** for **NeurIPS 2024**! ⭐
Our paper "Measuring Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty in LLMs: Empirical Evaluation on ID and OOD QA Tasks" is accepted to **UDM-KDD 2024**! Congratulations to **Kevin**! 🎉
I will serve as a Reviewer for **NeurIPS 2024**.
I will join **Prof. Yapeng Tian**'s lab to pursue a PhD at **University of Texas at Dallas**! 🌱
Our paper "AV-Mamba: Cross-Modality Selective State Space Models for Audio-Visual Question Answering" is accepted to **CVPR Sight and Sound Workshop 2024**! Congratulations to **Ziru**! 🎉
Our paper "Segment Any Out-of-Distribution Object" is accepted to **CVPR 2024**! Congratulations to **Wenjie**! 🎉
